profile.headline: Content Specialist | Writer | Editor | Front-End Web Development | Remote-Ready
profile.summary:
I'm a former educator and lifelong learner transitioning into frontend development. With a sharp eye for detail—honed through years as a professional writer, editor, and teacher—I’m able to quickly spot bugs, clean up messy code, and build user-friendly interfaces with clarity and precision.

I’ve completed most of Scrimba’s Frontend Developer Career Path (75% and counting!), earned professional certificates from IBM, Coursera, and Treehouse, and built a responsive portfolio showcasing HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React projects. Debugging and problem-solving have quickly become strengths, thanks to my background editing experience, my persistence, and curiosity.

I love the challenge of learning new technologies and improving with every project. Check out my portfolio for real-world samples of my work — and reach out if you’re looking for someone who blends communication skills with a developer’s mindset.

positions.title: Frontend Developer in Progress — 75% Complete
positions.locationName: Dallas County, Texas, United States · Remote
positions.description: Actively progressing through comprehensive frontend development training, including hands-on projects and real-world coding challenges. Building skills in JavaScript, React, HTML, CSS, and more — preparing for a professional developer role.
positions.insights: Skills: Git/GitHub · React · Editing · Debugging Code · HTML/CSS · Responsive Web Design · JavaScript · Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG)

positions.title: Special Education Teacher (EC–6)
positions.description:
Created individualized educational plans and learning tools for students with diverse needs. This experience sharpened your attention to detail, flexibility, and problem-solving under pressure.

Developed custom learning materials to support varied cognitive and emotional needs

Monitored data and adjusted methods—just like testing and iterating in code

Communicated regularly with parents and professionals—experience with stakeholder collaboration
positions.insights: Skills: Instructional Writing · Communication · Classroom Instruction

positions.title: 10th Grade English & ESL Teacher
positions.locationName: Williams High School – Plano, TX · On-site
positions.description:
Taught both native and non-native English speakers, developing strategies to support language learners. Strengthened communication skills that now translate to writing clear documentation and intuitive UI copy.

Adapted lessons to support multilingual learners with different proficiencies

Used creativity and visuals to make abstract ideas accessible—like I now do with UI elements

Built positive relationships and used empathy—essential in user-centered design
positions.insights: Skills: Proofreading · Instructional Writing · Communication · Classroom Instruction

positions.title: Content Writer and Editor
positions.description:
•	Perform necessary research and write website, blog copy, and various other communications according to clients’ desires.
•	Understand and incorporate special requirements according to each individual client.
•	Generate up-to-date, meaningful, well-written, concise copy incorporating appropriate keywords and hyperlinks.
•	Generate and edits meta tags and SEO’s for website optimization.
•	Provide and post social media and other copy to clients’ social media pages.
•	Collaborate with copy writers, contents managers, Web designers, and developers in effort to provide the desired outcome. 
•	Perform pre-deliver and post-deliver quality checks on all websites. 
•	Edit websites and other company copy for spelling, grammar, punctuation, clarity, and accuracy.
positions.insights: Skills: Copy Editing · Proofreading · Blogging · Copywriting · Web Content · Communication

positions.title: Writing Instructor
positions.description:
•	Taught three (3) Composition I writing course loads. 
•	Planned and organized class instruction in creative, unique, and captivating ways to maximize student learning.  
•	Employed appropriate teaching and learning strategies to communicate subject matter to students.  
•	Modified instructional methods and strategies to meet diverse student needs.  
•	Utilized available instructional technology.
•	Encouraged the development of higher order thinking skills and communication skills through the use of appropriate assignments. 
•	Developed instructional materials including course syllabi, tests, quizzes, classroom assignments, major research and writing assignments, rubrics, and more, in accordance with course objectives. 
•	Established meaningful learning outcomes for all three courses. 
•	Evaluated student performance fairly and consistently.
•	Returned student work with appropriate comments and suggestions for improvement in a prompt manner to promote maximum learning.
•	Performed one-to-one student/teacher consultations.  
•	Maintained accurate records of student attendance and grades, to evaluate student progress.
•	Submitted final grade rosters according to deadlines. 
•	Demonstrated sensitivity to individual student needs and circumstances.
positions.insights: Skills: Proofreading · Instructional Writing · Communication · Classroom Instruction

positions.title: Writer and Editorial Assistant
positions.description:
•	Researched, compiled, organized, composed, and edited medical journal articles under stringent deadlines.
•	Wrote and edited websites, press releases, catalogues, brochures, advertisements, editorials, blogs, and various other communications. 
•	Worked closely with dentists, dental manufacturers, and other clients to gather information required to compose written materials.
•	Conducted interviews and performed follow-up communications when required. 
•	Performed as a ghost writer on several projects.
positions.insights: Skills: Copy Editing · Proofreading · Publishing · Press Releases · Copywriting · Feature Articles · Web Content · Communication
